up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme 'P450 reductase'. Join `metabolism` with `target_dictionary` on `enzyme_tid = tid`, filtering where `target_dictionary.pref_name = 'P450 reductase'`. Join `metabolism.substrate_record_id` to `compound_records` (aliased as `cr_sub`) to obtain the substrate name (`cr_sub.compound_name`) and its `molregno`. Then join `cr_sub.molregno` to `compound_structures` to retrieve the substrate structure (`compound_structures.canonical_smiles`). Join `metabolism.drug_record_id` to `compound_records` (aliased as `cr_drug`) to obtain the parent compound name (`cr_drug.compound_name`). Select the following columns: substrate structure (canonical_smiles), substrate name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion (`metabolism.met_conversion`), pathway (`metabolism.pathway_key`), and organism (`metabolism.organism`). Order by `metabolism.met_id` ascending and limit the result to 200 rows. Do not apply any additional filters.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_name, cr_drug.compound_name AS parent_compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN target_dictionary td ON m.enzyme_tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr_drug ON m.drug_record_id = cr_drug.record_id WHERE td.pref_name = 'P450 reductase' ORDER BY m.met_id ASC LIMIT 200
